verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own pages document large exit-side M&A experience for private technology companies, citing the Figma/Adobe and Facebook/WhatsApp deals and about $650B in transactions. Its Startup Resource Center also says it covers growth stages through 'preparing for exit.' Public-offering (IPO) experience is not documented anywhere in the evidence, and the M&A claims appear on a technology transactions page rather than a dedicated M&A practice page. Missing for 10: documented IPO/capital-markets experience for venture-backed companies, a dedicated M&A practice page, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Figma's proposed $20 billion acquisition by Adobe and Facebook's acquisition of WhatsApp, are the top two largest sales of a private technology company in history.
at every stage of growth, from formation to scaling to preparing for exit.
